prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1001; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows damage concentrated on the front driver-side corner, including a cracked bumper cover, a bent headlamp bracket, and a crushed fender with a scuffed hood edge. Most of these marks line up well with the impact described for a left turn into oncoming traffic. The hood and fender panels will be replaced rather than repaired, and the labor hours listed fit the scope of this work. No earlier damage to the vehicle has come to light during inspection. Two similar charges posted to the same day are still under review, and the shop has been asked to send supporting invoices before those items are approved.
